text.aria-label: Subtitle text 'Change in the quantile score between two arms (points of the substation's capacity; more negative means the first arm is better). The chain is an ERA5-trained stage 1 model plus a stage 2 calibrator; its lag anomalies use ERA5T, CAMS, and the ENS control member's early leads, with a 7-hour telemetry delay. N1 is an XGBoost quantile model trained on the ENS control member. 16 Primary substations; 73 forecast runs, one every 5 days, July 2025 to June 2026. Dot: estimate. Line: 99.17% interval, widened for the six planned contrasts. Solid rule: no difference.'
text.tspan: Change in the quantile score between two arms (points of the substation's capacity; more
negative means the first arm is better).
The chain is an ERA5-trained stage 1 model plus a stage 2 calibrator; its lag anomalies use
ERA5T, CAMS, and the ENS control member's early leads, with a 7-hour telemetry delay. N1 is
an XGBoost quantile model trained on the ENS control member.
16 Primary substations; 73 forecast runs, one every 5 days, July 2025 to June 2026.
Dot: estimate. Line: 99.17% interval, widened for the six planned contrasts. Solid rule: no
